summary.answer: Creates CoD.MinimapFogOfWar using LUI.UIElement.new( f1_arg2, f1_arg3, f1_arg4, f1_arg5, f1_arg6, f1_arg7, f1_arg8, f1_arg9 ). summary.answer: Constructs CoD.SpawnSelectionMap from the displayed menu/controller/layout arguments. Creates MinimapFogOfWar as CoD.MinimapFogOfWar.new, MapItems as LUI.UIImage.new, DeathMarker as CoD.DeathMarker.new, SpawnGroupMarker as CoD.SpawnGroupMarker.new, AutoSpawnMarker as CoD.SpawnRegionMarker.new, SpawnBeaconMarker as CoD.SpawnBeaconMarker.new, SpawnRegionCursor as CoD.SpawnRegionCursor.new. Installs 2 event/action/override bindings; each callback keeps its captured controller/menu/widget references and executes only on its bound delivery. The ordered effect contract retains every property, model, visual, navigation, callback and return mutation in source order; returning self is not proof the original game loads this widget.
